audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3, 5 and 6 read Skill while whys[3], whys[5], whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say Sett stays ahead — late literally says 'this matchup stays Sett-favored even late'.
audit.why: The packet gives Sett all seven rows at 53.06% over 1798 games; Tahm Kench's personal damage never overtakes Sett's.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 5, 6 -> Sett in both layers, ratings to 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Devour was called his W in four places ('his W Devour cooldown', 'Use W Devour to reposition'), and level 6 was written around a W spike.
audit.why: Devour is his R; Abyssal Dive is the W, on 21s at rank 1, and it knocks up. Confusing the two makes the all-in timing advice point at the wrong cooldown.
audit.corrected: Slots fixed in spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text, wants.you[1], wants.foe[1] and breakdown.cooldowns.
sources: champ-data/_kits/tahmkench.json (W Abyssal Dive cd 21/20/19/18/17 knockup; R Devour)

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said 'his Q slow is his only setup' and 'stuns at 3 passive stacks' without saying where the stacks come from, and it never mentioned Thick Skin's active.
audit.why: An Acquired Taste stacks from ANY damage he deals you, not just Tongue Lash — so a long auto trade arms the stun for free. Tongue Lash stuns only if you already carry three stacks. Thick Skin is a 3s-cooldown conversion of stored damage into a shield, which is the burst window that must be forced out first. And per the mirror: Facebreaker stuns only with enemies on both sides of Sett, so never let him stand between you and your wave.
audit.corrected: Written into report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Show Stopper' written without 'The' in spikes[1].text and whys[4]; 'Grey Health' used in place of the real ability name Thick Skin.
audit.why: Packet flagged the first; the second is community shorthand that hides which ability and cooldown you are actually playing around.

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive: matchup-defining — His escape + shield. All-in when down. Track it before every engage. - Tahm Kench Tongue Lash: Lashes out to damage + slow (stuns at 3 passive stacks). Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive: 21s at rank 1, and it knocks up — it is his W, his engage and his escape. - Tahm Kench Thick Skin: 3s, converts stored damage into a shield, so force it out before you commit.

edits.before: His escape + shield. All-in when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 21s at rank 1 — his only reposition. Commit the moment he dives away.

edits.before: Track Tahm Kench's Abyssal Dive: His escape + shield. All-in when down. When it is down — E-stun + W him.
edits.after: Any damage stacks An Acquired Taste — at three, his Tongue Lash stuns. Break the chain, then E-stun + W.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Facebreaker only stuns with a minion behind him — never let him step between.

edits.before: His R is a roam/save tool, not a duel button; keep the lane 1v1 and your Show Stopper punishes any greedy step-up he takes.
edits.after: Devour is his R and a save tool, not a duel button; keep the lane 1v1 and The Show Stopper punishes any greedy step-up.

edits.before: After a bruiser item you out-damage his passive Grey Health regen in a committed all-in — force the fight before his W Devour cooldown is up.
edits.after: After a bruiser item you out-damage Thick Skin's stored-damage shield in a committed all-in — force the fight while Abyssal Dive is still down.

edits.before: Q and E let you pull and burst past his Grey Health.
edits.after: Q and E pull and burst him past his Thick Skin shield.

edits.before: Level 6 your Show Stopper out-duels his roam-focused ult.
edits.after: At 6 The Show Stopper out-duels his roam-first Devour.

edits.before: All-in through his Grey Health while his W Devour is down
edits.after: All-in through Thick Skin while Abyssal Dive is down

edits.before: Use R to punish his step-ups since he can't cancel your suppression
edits.after: Use R to punish his step-ups while Abyssal Dive is on cooldown

edits.before: Use W Devour to reposition or escape your all-in
edits.after: Abyssal Dive out of your all-in and knock you up

notes: Devour was labelled as Tahm Kench's W across four fields — worth a repo-wide grep, since the same templated strings likely appear on other Tahm Kench pages. Suppression wording removed from wants.you[2] rather than repeated: Sett's R is described only as a carry-and-slam, and Abyssal Dive carries no dash flag, so I did not claim his R grounds it either.
